review.why: Runs a structured mock interview for a job posting, probes vague answers and scores each answer with quotes.
review.summary: Plays the interviewer for a chosen round, persona and difficulty. Builds a question plan from the job description, asks one question at a time, probes with quoted specifics and scores answers on written anchors, after each answer (coach mode) or at the end (realistic). Model answers use only the user's real experience.
strengths: Quote-backed scoring against written anchors: no quote, no rating
Never invents the user's experience; gaps are marked [NEED: ...]
Covers behavioral, coding, system design, case and panel rounds
cautions: Very long (43,000 characters) with five reference files
Typed practice cannot judge pace or tone
Declines to feed answers during a live interview, by design
